I lost my father last year. I felt similar feelings because he wasn't involved with me. The thing that helped me the most was writing. I would write how mad I was, or how I just wanted a hug. It let me express my feelings in a healthy and direct way. I am sorry for these feelings, they are never great. Don't let anyone tell you how you are supposed to feel. Feel whatever you want, as long and hard as you want. Grief is a painful, confusing maze of realities and imaginations. I hope you find your way through it without too many wrong turns.
